_comment: TEMPLATE – files starting with an underscore are ignored by the build. Copy this file to a new name (e.g. 2026-12-my-story.json), remove this _comment line, fill in every field, set status to 'published' and run: npm run build
headline: Headline shown on the page and in listings
subheadline: Optional one-sentence standfirst shown under the headline.
description: Short summary (120–160 characters) used in listings, RSS and as fallback meta description.
author: editorial-team

image.alt: Describe what is visible in the image for screen readers and SEO
image.caption: Caption shown under the image.

seo.title: Optional SEO title (max ~60 chars). Defaults to headline.
seo.description: Optional meta description (max ~155 chars). Defaults to description.

body: DATELINE — Plain strings become paragraphs. Inline HTML such as links, emphasis and bold is allowed.

body.text: A pull quote or direct quotation.

body.html: A highlighted editor's note or correction box.
A closing italic note, e.g. a correction or disclosure.
